steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Huh? Oh... uh, no.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I just...

options: We can look for it ourselves.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I chose to be your guide. Besides, I want to know the truth about Oka too.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Worst case scenario, I guess they exile me...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The path ahead seems to be safe, Doctor. I do not detect any lifeforms—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Huh?
Ksenia glances at Mon3tr, then quickly and awkwardly looks away.
You notice the researcher has been following Mon3tr quietly, looking to her from time to time. Even Mon3tr has noticed it now.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You keep glancing at me, Ksenia... do I look weird?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: What? No, no!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: It's just, seeing you brings back memories.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What memories?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: You see... the problem is that I don't remember them clearly.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: It's so distant that it's become faded and indistinct, like ink on a piece of paper that's been submerged in water...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: But... may I ask you a couple of questions?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Of course! I only hope I can answer them.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: You said your name is Mon3tr?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Yes, that's what they call me.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Mon3tr... Mon3tr.
She chews on the unfamiliar name.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Mon3tr, do you—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Do you feel cold...?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Wh-What I mean is, you're quite lightly dressed.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I can give you my jacket, if you need it. It'll at least keep the wind off you before we enter the mines.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I guess it might be a little too old—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I-I get it! There's no need!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It took me a little while to process it because you're the first one to ask me this question. But no, I'm really not cold!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: No, I'm not cold. But thank you for the offer!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Were you about to say something, Doctor?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Ah... alright.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Perhaps your constitution is strong, and the cold doesn't bother you.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Yes! I'm strong!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's alright, Ksenia. You can trust us.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We'll be walking together for a while. Feel free to ask any questions.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: You said you were colleagues of Director Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Is... is Director Kal'tsit well?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I... I wouldn't say that.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I was Professor Ilia's assistant. I didn't have much interaction with Director Kal'tsit personally.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: All I remember is a few...

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: Ksenia! Ksenia!

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Y-Yes, Professor!

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: Why isn't the experiment data from this morning on my desk?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I'm sorry! I'll go get it right now!

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: How many times do I have to tell you? You need to be able to keep up with the pacing, if you want to be part of the project. If all I wanted was someone to copy instrument readings onto paper, my three-year-old daughter could do it.

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: And what are these scribbles? Energy conversion equations?

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: Do your job first, Ksenia, before you try anything new.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What is this?

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: D-Director Kal'tsit. It's nothing, nothing to waste your time on.

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: Ksenia is still young. It'll take time for her to get used to working on an active project. I'll take responsibility for any mistakes...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did you come up with this equation yourself?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The theoretical model is quite creative, and the simulation model is sound. The equation would form the basis of highly efficient power supplies, if it can be successfully established.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Kinetic energy loss has not been taken into account, however, and more validation of the data is necessary.

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: Good grief...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I... I'm sorry, Director Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's no need to apologize. You took initiative, you wanted to be a part of what's going on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can listen in on the next report session, if you want.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And don't be so hard on her, Ilia. One should encourage the enthusiasm of youth appropriately.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You made worse mistakes when you were her age.

steps.name: Ilia
steps.text: You're right. I understand.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Th-Thank you...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: It's true that Director Kal'tsit inspired me at one point.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Like many who were there, I had hoped that research into the Sarcophagus would yield a new form of clean energy that could benefit everyone.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: That way, miners would be liberated from the dangers of the mines, and the lives of the Infected would no longer be needed to fuel this monstrosity by the name of Ursus.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I was young, naive... it never occurred to me that a country's character, like the character of a person, is not so easily shaken or changed.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Regardless, I was very happy I got to hear Director Kal'tsit's name after the accident.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I thought, maybe I would have a chance to...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: See her again?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Sorry! Forget I ever said anything. I assume it's something you may not answer.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I just thought... you look like you might know the Director. Perhaps you knew her, knew where she went, and if she's doing well.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: But I suppose it was never my place to know...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Ksenia.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You'll see Kal'tsit again. I promise.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Oh, so you mean she is still...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I am delighted to hear that.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We'll see Kal'tsit again, won't we, Doctor?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I look forward to it...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: Should I get the chance, I would like to go to this 'Rhodes Island' that Director Kal'tsit founded, and which Serafina has mentioned...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: One moment... something's not right...

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: We didn't see anyone on the way, did we?

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: No miners, and even though we're very near the mine shafts, we haven't seen a single guard, a single Patrol Unit.

options: The Grand Duchess put the entire mining district on lockdown.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I know about the lockdown. But the transfer—

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: No... What I know is completely different.

steps.name: Ksenia
steps.text: I thought the only problem was the failure of the Oka experiments. I never heard anything about the mining district being cleaned up.

options: We've hardly encountered any resistance since we entered the district.
The defenses are even sparser than inside Bresk.

steps.text: Rankin puts the finishing touches by carving on the door of the carriage, then throws away the rock.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: I know how to draw the symbol now. I'll help next time.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Sure. You can do it next time.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: I'm done over here. Have we gotten the stuff out of the other containers?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Pavel's side is done. The last two containers didn't have much in the way of useful supplies. Should we remove the mechanical components and take them with us?

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: You said you used to work in the machine factories in the city?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Take a few parts that can be used on other machines. Maybe we can sell them for money.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Assuming anyone would buy them...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We must also take the injured into account.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Gospozha Serafina.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We have too many injured. It's not realistic to immediately continue the journey on foot.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We need rest.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: Rankin! We took inventory and we should have enough food to last two or three days if we ration it. It should last us until the next village.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: I thought there would be more... but I suppose we should be glad to have what we have.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: Vetochki found some nuts stockpiled by musbeasts. It'll sate the hunger for a while, and it doesn't spoil easily.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: Right now, we need medical supplies more than we need food—

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Where do we find it?

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Only way is the nomadic cities, or a mobile medical post. If we can contact one...
Rankin looks towards Raidian.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I can attempt to contact a nearby mobile medical post.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Thank you, Gospozha Serafina.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Don't thank me so soon. I have a condition.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: We appreciate what you and your team have done for us, but in our current circumstances—

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The injured must stay put while I attempt to contact the mobile medical posts.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: It's my judgment as a medical professional that they need rest.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The kind of rest that isn't bumpy.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: Who are you taking?

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Lidiya, Pavel, and a few sweet talkers who could coax coins out of their supervisors.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: You didn't like those slick talkers from the ore-washing plant.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: It has nothing to do with my preferences.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: Why not me? Because I might argue with you?

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: We're seeking help from a nearby village, not soliciting donations from a noble banquet in Grypherburg, barin. Your way won't work with farmers who can't even write their own name.

spans.text: We're seeking help from a nearby village, not soliciting donations from a noble banquet in Grypherburg,
. Your way won't work with farmers who can't even write their own name.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: Call me that again, and I'll break your nose.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: You'll break your knuckles on it.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: You don't think seeking help from the village is a good idea.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: ...Right.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Until Gospozha Serafina makes contact with a mobile medical post, however, we can't sit around doing nothing.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: We're not injured.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: We've sat around doing nothing. We sang and danced—you played the accordion!

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: All past tense. Our supplies will run out soon. I must do what I can before that happens.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: While we're gone... I need you to stay here and take care of those staying behind.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: I doubt the villagers would be charitable this time.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Of course. Few people are glad to open their door and see an Infected standing in it. We've already learned that.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: How long has Rankin been in there? Should we check it out?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Calm down. Rankin told us to wait.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: But last time—

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Come out, Vetochki. I know you were following us. Rankin must have known, too. He just chose not to say anything.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Why didn't you stay behind with Nikto and the others? You need to take care of your babushka, don't you?

spans.text: Why didn't you stay behind with Nikto and the others? You need to take care of your

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Babushka said, it's alright...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I wanted to, help. So I, came. I can, h-help!

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Did Nikto know that you came with us? He might have thought that you went missing.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I left, a... note.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: That works. You know, I thought you could be useful with us, but Rankin wouldn't have it.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Wh-Where has, uchitel, gone?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: He's going to negotiate with them, see if we can get some food.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Wh-What do we, have to t-trade?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Parts from the vehicles.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: But he went over empty-handed!

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Maybe he wanted to show that he means no harm. People might get the wrong idea if he was holding a weapon or a chunk of metal.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: But he didn't take anything the last time either, and those people stalled for time while they sneaked someone out to call for the Patrol Units—

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: I have to help him!

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Pavel!

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Chyort... wait up!

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: (Hushed) Stop it!

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: Rankin is inside—
The miner covers her colleague's mouth with her hand and pulls him to one side.
They can hear the indistinct sound of talking coming from inside the house.

steps.name: Voice from Inside
steps.text: ...Understood...

steps.name: Voice from Inside
steps.text: (Sound of metal grinding)

steps.name: Voice from Inside
steps.text: ...We've... informed...

steps.name: Voice from Inside
steps.text: (Sound of impact)

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) Something doesn't sound right.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: Mmmpppphhh—

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) Promise you won't just kick down the door, and I'll let go.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: (Nods)
As soon as he can breathe again, the miner points towards the back door of the house.
There, clear as day on the snow, is a row of footprints leading away from the house.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) ...Govno.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) One of you, go knock on the door. Act anxious and spin a story when they answer the door.

steps.name: Slick Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) Why don't YOU go? If they've got Rankin, whoever knocks on the door is next, isn't it?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: (Whisper) I-I'll go.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) No, Vetochki—
Vetochki taps lightly on the door with her knuckles.
The sound from inside ceases.

steps.name: Voice from Inside
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: (Whisper) ...Keep knocking.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: (Knocks)

steps.name: Voice from Inside
steps.text: Back so soon...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: What's going on—

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Are you alright, Rankin?

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Lidiya? I thought I told you to wait outside—

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: ...Vetochki?

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: So you're all miners who came out under orders to find supplies.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Yes, sir! I must apologize for what that fool did. He spends so much time underground that he's forgotten how to tell a good person from a bad one.

steps.name: Excited Miner
steps.text: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry. We had a bad experience when we tried to seek help from another village, and I thought this would be the same—

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Pavel.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: You're honest about things. I have a fair idea how people from other villages treat the Infected... most of Ursus is like that.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: But you're not those Infected that don't care about authority and just want to cause trouble. You're miners, right?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Yes! You know, of course, that we can't leave the mining district without permission from up high.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: This is our foreman right here. They told him not to go back until he's found supplies.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Would the bosses leave you to starve if you don't find it?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Yes. It's not so bad for adults like us, but kids like Vetochki over here, how are they supposed to grow without eating?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Vetochki? This girl? She's a miner too?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: How old are you...?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I-I'm—

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Let me guess. Ten?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Fifteen.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Haha. You're shy, like my daughter... she might have a child your age now, if she's still alive.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: She went to the mines after she got the Stone Disease. Not around these parts, to the east, the Northern Tundra? It's further away, anyhow.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Th-The mines, are good. D-Don't worry... dedushka.

spans.text: Th-The mines, are good. D-Don't worry...

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Dedushka... grandpa, huh...?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: I don't even know how and when she got sick. She wouldn't say. I haven't heard from her for a long time.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Let's not talk about that! Sounds like you have people running your mining district. Some places don't care about their miners at all, giving them nothing to eat, and they don't give them any other way out either.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: I heard some miners got so desperate they ran away. They'd rather risk the Patrol Units.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Can you help us?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: My wife went out to discuss things with the others before you came in.

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: So those footprints were...

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: You have the parts, Lidiya?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: Right here.
Rankin takes the cloth package and gives it to the old man.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Here, you should be able to replace the aging parts on your harvester with it.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: In exchange for the food you shared with us.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Sure, sure... honestly, I don't know anything about harvesters other than that it's been broken for a while. Do you mind helping me fit the part on if you want to help?

steps.name: Calm Miner
steps.text: I'll take a look. I used to work in a machine factory.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: That's great.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: You really managed to get food. A fair bit of it, too.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Gennady says it was a good year for crops, but his harvester was broken. They managed to harvest the mossoat by hand, only to have surplus grain sitting around in granaries because the caravans didn't come this year.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Life is hard for everyone without cash. Still, they were willing to barter with us, rather than waiting until spring to sell.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: Lidiya said those parts are worth more than mossoat.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: As far as we're concerned, food is priceless.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Must you go so soon?

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Yes. We've accomplished our mission. It's time to go back.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: I had hoped that you would fill your bellies before you go.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: If you want, there are a few houses on the west end of the village that have been empty since the previous inhabitants left. Your group can take shelter there, make a fire, get warm and make some food.

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Spasibo...

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: I can't tell you how grateful I am.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: There's no need. The girl helped us repair the harvester for next year. We're the ones who should thank you.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Besides, it's not like we did much.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Normally, we don't touch the collective food stores for winter. Patrol Units are less frequent these days, but it's a chore when the tax collectors come around.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: All we old folks did was to take a little grain out of our own reserves, so that you can go back and say you've done your job.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Not like there's anything else we can help with—

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Maybe you can tell us your daughter's name. We can try to ask when we—uh, return to the mining district.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Oh, she's not here in the Far North! She's in the Northern Tundra, far to the east...

steps.name: Rankin
steps.text: Just tell me.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Well, I suppose it can do no harm.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Her name is Milana...
A pair of blank, soulless eyes gaze out from the darkness.
The cracking of the bonfire hides his indistinct mutter.

steps.name: Hawley
steps.text: Achieve...

steps.name: Hawley
steps.text: Salvation.
